observations: Photo 0 shows the back of a black console with a white label that includes 'XBOX ONE' and 'SUCCESS GAMES AND GADGETS' watermark.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same console, with visible scratches and wear on the black plastic casing.
A black Xbox controller is placed in front of the console in both photos.
The console appears to be in a retail or storage environment with glass shelves in the background.
No power adapter is visible in either photo.
The console's disc drive is visible in photo 0, suggesting it is a standard Xbox One model.

claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox one console with one pad and power adaptor
claims.evidence: No power adaptor is visible in either photo. The controller is present, but the claim about the power adaptor is not supported by the images.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, displaying the Xbox dashboard, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Power adaptor may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photo of the power adaptor with its plug and cable, showing it is present and intact.

risks.risk: Controller may be non-functional or have dead buttons/axes
risks.proof: Video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses and analog stick movement.

risks.risk: Console may have disc drive issues or be non-functional
risks.proof: Video showing the console reading and playing a disc.
risks.if_unproven: priced as disc drive not working

proof_requests: Photo of the power adaptor with its plug and cable.
Video showing the console powering on and displaying the Xbox dashboard.
Video showing the controller connecting and responding to inputs.
Video showing the console reading and playing a disc.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
